verdict.rationale: Asana's evidence shows general integration primitives (REST API, webhooks, App Directory apps that 'create Asana tasks and kick start workflow from other tools') that could support a repo-issue-tracker sync, but there is no first-party documentation of a dedicated, bi-directional GitHub/GitLab/Jira issue sync feature. missing for 10: explicit native bi-directional issue-tracker integration docs, evidence of two-way sync (not just task creation from other tools), engineer hands-on confirmation the sync avoids duplication.
